topics.label: Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the lecture objectives, sets expectations, and frames the discussion around the hallmarks of cancer and tumor progression models.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Proliferation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptors and downstream signaling cascades drive sustained proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic disruptions halt terminal cell differentiation in both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal epithelium.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the molecular mechanisms by which cancer cells bypass programmed cell death through alterations in p53 and the Bcl-2 protein family.

topics.label: Telomere Maintenance and Replicative Immortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the Hayflick limit, the protective role of senescence, and the genetic mechanisms cancers use to upregulate telomerase and achieve replicative immortality.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex phenotypic hallmarks and explain how cancer cells alter metabolic pathways through aerobic glycolysis, Krebs cycle mutations, and oncometabolite production.

topics.label: Induction of Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details why developing a blood supply is necessary for tumor growth and how the balance of regulatory signals mediates the angiogenic switch.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the biological stages of metastatic dissemination, factors determining metastatic efficiency, and the genomic features associated with secondary tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the lecture, discusses current perspectives on cancer hallmarks, reviews the core learning takeaways, and invites questions.
